# AI Career Graph

> A data-driven guide to how AI is reshaping work across 8 countries and 4,500+ occupations. For each job we publish an AI automation-risk score, a "human moat" (what stays hard to automate), the AIOE academic exposure index, salary bands, technical-migration pathways, required skills, and future career routes. Content is available in 11 languages.

Coverage: Australia (AU), New Zealand (NZ), Canada (CA), United States (US), United Kingdom (UK), Germany (DE), France (FR), Spain (ES). Every occupation page combines official classification codes (ANZSCO / NOC / SOC / KldB / ROME / CNO) with AI-impact analysis.

URL pattern: `/{country}/{locale}/{category}/{slug}/` for occupation pages; `/{locale}/` for global pages. English (`en`) is the primary index below; other locales: de, es, id, ja, ms, pt, th, vi, zh-CN, zh-Hant.

## Global entry points
- [Home](https://aicareergraph.com/en/): overview and occupation search
- [AI Impact Map](https://aicareergraph.com/en/ai-graph/): visual map of AI exposure across occupations
- [Rankings](https://aicareergraph.com/en/rankings/): occupations ranked by automation risk, salary and other metrics
- [About](https://aicareergraph.com/en/about/): methodology, data sources and scoring model

## Methodology notes
- AI automation-risk and "human moat" scores are stored on a 10-point scale.
- The AIOE (AI Occupational Exposure) index is an academic measure crosswalked from occupation classification codes; it is available for AU, NZ, CA, US, UK and DE.
- Salary bands and migration pathways are country-specific and reflect local classification systems.
